root_idea.summary: A basic principle of removing or exposing something by taking it away from its place or surface.
root_idea.development: The root develops from removal and uncovering to wind-driven carrying away, uprooting, eradication, and related material or figurative changes.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form rather than the inflected QAC lemma.
Displayed separately as the Quran-attested verbal noun.

senses.definition: To uproot, remove, carry away, or scatter something.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for the removal or dispersal of an object from its place; the Quran also uses the passive form for something being scattered or blown away.

senses.definition: To cast something away into water in a dust-like dispersal.
senses.usage_conditions: A specific Quranic construction in which the object is thrown into the sea as scattered dust or fine material.

senses.definition: Scattering, uprooting, carrying away, or casting away as dust.
senses.usage_conditions: The verbal noun of نَسَفَ; in the Quran it describes dispersal into dust-like particles and the casting of an object away in that manner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel that throws up earth with its forefoot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the camel's action in casting soil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dust raised from the earth; by analogy, foam.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The foam sense is an analogical extension from material that rises or is cast off like dust.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a vessel, filled so that foam or froth rises over it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression إِناءٌ نَسْفَانٌ for a vessel in this condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a color, to become altered from its former hue, as though covered with dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic Form VIII use describing a change in the appearance of a color.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stone used to scrape dirt from the foot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized implement for removing dirt from the foot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of speech, altered and slight or scant in substance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of speech that has become changed and diminished.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vessel in which dates or grain are shaken to remove dust and other residue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A named implement associated with separating dust from dates or grain.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The wind-carried removal of dust is covered by the Quranic remove-and-scatter sense.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the Form I entry; it adds no independent lexical meaning.
The dust-separating vessel is represented as a distinct Classical Arabic meaning.

cautions: The Quranic contextual renderings “scatter,” “blast,” “blown away,” and “particles” reflect related forms and constructions rather than separate meanings for every English gloss.
